content.text: The diff is purely presentational: it removes an in-header "Add a piece" link and re-adds the same link (same static `href="/closet/upload"`, same `aria-label`) as a fixed-position floating action button, and swaps the `Plus` icon for `Camera`. No data enters any sink, no auth/authz logic changes, no new user input paths, no template/HTML injection surface (no `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`, no dynamic href/src, no user-controlled className interpolation). The surrounding server logic (Supabase auth check + `items` query filtered by `archived=false` under RLS) is unchanged.
